uncertainty.reason: Only four timestamped facts are available, with no logs, metrics detail, deployment contents, or explicit event ordering. Two candidate factors (deployment and DB latency) coincide in the same narrow time window, but the evidence provides no causal linkage between them or to the checkout failures — correlation in timing is the only signal present, and the evidence itself states root cause is unconfirmed.
